DISCUSSION ITEM

Tuesday, April 11, 2023  2
 1.  SUBJECT:  A RESOLUTION OF NO CONFIDENCE IN SUPERVISOR NATHAN
  FLETCHER AND A REQUEST FOR HIS IMMEDIATE RESIGNATION
  EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY (DISTRICTS: ALL)

  OVERVIEW
  On March 29th District 4 Supervisor Nathan Fletcher announced his resignation from the San
  Diego County Board of Supervisors effective at the end of his medical leave. By his own
  statements, Supervisor Fletcher has demonstrated he has not upheld the principles of integrity
  expected in his position as a member of the County Board of Supervisors.

  As a County we pride ourselves in having a Code of Ethics and robust workplace standards of
  conduct which should be honored and respected by all, regardless of position.

  Through this action, the Board is requested to adopt a resolution of no confidence in Supervisor
  Nathan Fletcher and request his resignation effective immediately.

  RECOMMENDATION(S)
  CHAIRWOMAN NORA VARGAS
  Adopt the Resolution titled: A RESOLUTION OF NO CONFIDENCE IN SUPERVISOR
  NATHAN FLETCHER AND A REQUEST FOR HIS IMMEDIATE RESIGNATION
  EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY

  EQUITY IMPACT STATEMENT
  The County of San Diego Standards of Conduct for the workplace are founded on ethical
  behavior. The County is committed to the principle of treating each employee with respect and
  dignity and is committed to a work environment free from unlawful discrimination and
  harassment.

  SUSTAINABILITY IMPACT STATEMENT
  The proposed action supports the County of San Diego Sustainability Goal of providing just and
  equitable access to County services, policy decision-making and resource allocation for the
  region and its residents.

  FISCAL IMPACT
  There are no fiscal impacts associated with this action.

  BUSINESS IMPACT STATEMENT
  N/A
